bullets.text: Activities per advisor reached 10.4 this week versus 10.1 the prior week (+3.4%), slightly above the trailing 13-week average of 10.1. ON ranks 2 of 2 in its parent group.
Among children, GTA rose 17.8% to 10.6 activities per advisor, while EON fell 8.5% to 10.3.
Outbound calls fell 3.3% to 59.0, appointments booked fell 11.8% to 15.0, and clients contacted fell 9.2% to 59.0.
Call-to-appointment rate rose to 25.4% from 23.0%, while the show rate fell to 83.3% from 90.0% and the no-show rate rose to 16.7% from 10.0%.
Appointment conversion was 53.3% versus 44.4% the prior week. 13-week coverage rose to 88.7%. EON led on coverage at 91.4% against GTA at 85.9%.

answer.headline: Ontario activities per advisor rose 3.4% this week to 10.4, up from 10.1 the prior week.

watchlist.reason: Show rate fell to 78.6% from 87.5% this week and ranks 2 of 2, as does its 13-week coverage at 85.9%.
Activities per advisor fell 8.5% to 10.3 this week and rank 2 of 2, as does appointment conversion at 50.0%.
